one_line: Hold the object you are talking about in frame one, with a headline card and word-by-word captions.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 close selfie, a crumpled diaper held low, a water bottle lifted at 0:01. Said (transcript): 'אם את מחכה שהילד שלך יגיד לך... את יכולה לחכות לנצח'. Two white boxes: 'מתכננת להתחיל לפרידה מהחיתול? ככה עושים את זה נכון'.
q1_hook.why: A blunt claim aimed at a mother planning to start potty training, with the prop already in hand, gives a concrete reason to stay (H1). Face, voice, headline card and subtitle all arrive in the first second (H4, H6, T3). The promise 'ככה עושים את זה נכון' states the value early (H2).

beats.what: Close selfie, diaper in hand, bottle lifted at 0:01; headline boxes plus subtitle 'אם את מחכה'
beats.why: Claim, prop and headline arrive together, with no greeting.

beats.what: 'לנצח!' enlarged at 0:04, then 'ולמה?' and 'הוא בעצם מייצר לו תחושה שקרית'
beats.why: A one-word question hands the viewer the reason next.

beats.what: Wider framing, she squeezes the diaper: 'הטכנולוגיה של החיתול היום היא האויב'; 'שהכל' enlarged 0:15
beats.why: The prop makes an invisible idea (absorbency hides wetness) visible.

beats.what: Grey patterned pants, bottle tilted over them: 'מתי הוא לומד את' ... 'נכון, כשמתחילים'
beats.why: A second prop and the key claim: wetness is learned in underwear.

beats.what: Names the fear ('צמרמורות' 😅), then holds up the pants: 'אבל הפספוס הזה', 'הכי שלו', 'נופל'
beats.why: Names the parent's fear, then reframes accidents as teaching.

beats.what: Props gone from view; hands gesture: 'וכאן מתחיל תהליך הלמידה', 'ומשחרר' enlarged at 0:55
beats.why: Method stays abstract; no steps shown, the visual proof has stopped.

beats.what: Hands wide: 'כמה שיותר מהר ובקלילות ובלי לחץ'; 'כשאת מגיעה מוכנה, גם הילד שלך'
beats.why: The tagline of the argument, in a reassuring tone.

beats.what: 'ואם את מתכננת להתחיל', 'מוכנה' 💪, 'תמשיכי לעקוב כאן', 'וגם בפיד,', 'אחרי חיתול!'
beats.why: One ask, spoken and subtitled, ends on a smile with no dead tail.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: A follow ask only (voice, subtitles, caption). No question to answer in comments, no comment word, no explicit save or send ask.
q2_flow.why: Short questions ('ולמה?' 0:05, 'מתי הוא לומד את זה?' 0:24) are answered in the next line (H5). Props change the picture every 8 to 15 s up to 0:48 (R3, E2). Then 30 s of talk remain, and 'how to do it right' gets a principle, not steps (R1). Nothing prompts a send (R5).

q3_cta.what: Said and subtitled from 1:14 (transcript): 'תמשיכי לעקוב כאן גם בסטורי וגם בפיד', then 'אחרי חיתול!' at 1:18. Caption: 'תעקבי ותצטרפי לחגיגהה' and 'ויאלה אחרי פסח הילד בלי חיתול!!'. No link, no comment word, no offer.
q3_cta.why: One action (follow) in voice, subtitle and caption, after the value, inside the safe zone (C1, C6). It has a stated reason (arrive prepared), so it is not bait (C2). But it is a soft follow with no next step such as a guide or keyword (C3 absent).

q4_shown.what: A diaper pack in her hands 0:00 to about 0:23 (logo partly visible, brand not confirmed), a water bottle, then child's grey patterned pants 0:24 to 0:48. A yellow pack at the table edge from 0:52. No product for sale, no price, no child.
q4_shown.why: Props turn a spoken idea into something seen, which is why the first minute holds (R3, F8). The proof is her explanation only: no credential on screen, and a strong claim about the child's brain stated as fact without a source (K4). LumeBook's book is not in this Reel.

q5_edit.what: 16 shots in 80 s, about 5 s each (detected cuts). Mostly jump cuts in the same table scene, with punch-in size changes; no speed changes seen. Subtitles in 1 to 4 word chunks, key words enlarged. Ends on a smile, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Cuts every few seconds in one scene remove pauses without confusing it (E2). Short synced chunks with emphasis words read as keywords, not a transcript (E4, T2). At 80 s it is long for one idea (R2, R1). It ends on the ask, no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: Why a diaper delays a child noticing wetness and why accidents in underwear teach, for a mother about to start potty training after Passover.
q6_topic.why: A concrete parenting milestone with a named fear ('צמרמורות') and a 'no pressure' reassurance fits what parents come for (K6). The 'after Passover' end date ties it to a real start moment (K7). The tone is warm and steady but has no single surprise or laugh peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone selfie at a table in a bright room with a large window behind her; close and slightly moving in the first shot, then a static medium shot (propped or held still). Clip-on lapel mic visible. One adult on camera, no child.
q7_filmed.why: A real home, window light and a lapel mic give the creator look with clear speech (H8, F7). She talks to the lens, to 'את' (F6). The face fills the frame so it reads on a phone.

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00 to about 0:02: two white boxes in the upper third, 'מתכננת להתחיל לפרידה מהחיתול?' and 'ככה עושים את זה נכון' 👇. Then white subtitles without a box, centred at about 60 to 64% of the frame height, 1 to 4 words per chunk, key words enlarged ('לנצח!' 0:04, 'שהכל' 0:15, 'ומשחרר' 0:55, 'מוכנה' 💪 1:13, 'אחרי חיתול!' 1:18).
q8_text.caption: 'מתכננת להתחיל פרידה מהחיתול?' Four short lines, about 22 words: the hook question, a promise ('כשאת תגידי מוכנה גם הילד שלך יהיה מוכן'), a follow ask, an end date. Emojis, no hashtags, no question for comments, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: A headline card in the first second states the topic (T3), and subtitles let a muted viewer follow (T1). Both sit clear of the top 14% and mostly above the bottom 35% (T4). The caption's first line repeats the hook and uses the search words 'פרידה מהחיתול', but has no hashtags (T7).

weak_points: Eighty seconds of talk with the props gone after 0:48; a headline that promises how to do it right but gives no steps; a strong brain claim with no source; a follow ask with no concrete next step.
lumebook_takeaway: Hold the printed book or one spread in one hand to a propped phone, say the parent's worry in the first line, and burn in a headline plus word captions.
not_verified: The diaper brand; any professional credential; music (none evident, speech runs wall to wall). Whether water is poured onto the diaper at 0:01 or onto the pants at 0:25 is not clear in the sampled frames (first pass said both). The 720 x 1280 size is the saved copy, not necessarily the posted file. Correction: hook text boxes are gone by 0:03. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
